question: Across every completed actual Live economic position through 2026-08-25, does one predeclared causal path burden repeat broadly enough to justify exactly one adjacent historical observation unit without selecting a management rule from the small Live sample?

economic_population.included: T03 through T15, exactly 13 completed economic positions
exclude: T01 V1 entry-deal publication-race safety close
T02 V2 stale-or-zero result-price protection close
the 2026-08-25 Passive order that expired unfilled
the CXR1 protective-order false safety stop as an event or cause
the later Cross window that was not evaluated while entries were stopped
manual-close hypotheticals and hindsight-only trade selection
economic_population.operating_incident_policy: Use exclusions only to keep the economic sample uncontaminated. Do not diagnose, compare, explain or derive any operating hypothesis in unit 020.

fixed_measurement.mark: Executable-side floating mark before costs: bid for BUY and ask for SELL, at actual entry price and volume, matching the closed forensics convention.
fixed_measurement.mfe_to_final_giveback_usd: maximum executable mark minus actual realized net
fixed_measurement.peak_fraction: elapsed seconds from entry to MFE divided by total lifecycle seconds
fixed_measurement.qualified_profit_memory: final actual net is nonpositive and MFE is at least +0.50 USD
fixed_measurement.late_maturity_winner: final actual net is positive and MFE peak_fraction is at least 0.75
fixed_measurement.cohort_peak_giveback: all active cohort legs were simultaneously positive and the combined executable peak exceeded eventual combined realized net by at least 1.00 USD
fixed_measurement.directional_unlock: an equal-volume same-symbol opposite-direction pair was jointly positive, one leg ended natively, and the surviving leg later finished negative

t15_replay.purpose: Recover only T15 tick-path MFE, MAE, MFE time and first +0.50 USD crossing that are absent from the immutable event ledger.
t15_replay.runtime: one isolated Lab Portable 2026-08-25 through 2026-08-26 100%-real-tick path
t15_replay.source: one self-contained Tester-only measurement EA with no trade object, order function, position function or Live dependency
integrity: MetaEditor build 6140 reports 0 errors and 0 warnings.
CopyTicksRange returns at least one US30 tick inside the exact actual lifecycle.
The reconstructed adverse mark reaches the recorded stop outcome within 0.05 USD before costs.
The output contains exactly one T15 row and no order or deal is generated.
t15_replay.failure_action: Close T15 path fields as unavailable; do not add a second replay or use an approximate bar rescue. The T03-T14 fixed aggregation may still be judged.

requirements: Qualified losses span at least two strategies and three server dates.
Qualified losses are at least 75% of all included economic losses.
Their summed MFE-to-final giveback is at least 8.00 USD.
INDIVIDUAL_PROFIT_MEMORY.passing_action: Retain exactly one next unit that observes profit-state memory on broad frozen-control history before any management action or threshold can be selected.

requirements: At least two qualifying cohorts on at least two server dates.
At least two distinct strategy compositions.
Summed cohort peak-to-eventual giveback is at least 3.00 USD.
COHORT_PEAK_MEMORY.passing_action: Descriptive only because portfolio-exit-coordination-v1 already tested and rejected generic cohort-close and cohort-floor mechanisms across 16 real-tick paths; it cannot be selected again in this bundle.

requirements: At least two qualifying unlock episodes on different server dates.
At least two distinct surviving strategies.
The surviving legs lose at least 1.00 USD in aggregate after unlock.
DIRECTIONAL_UNLOCK.passing_action: Retain exactly one next broad historical observation of opposite-leg release; no close or hedge rule is selected in unit 020.

requirements: They span at least two strategies and three server dates.
They are at least one third of all actual economic winners.
late_maturity_guard.effect: If the guard passes, any retained next observation must explicitly measure late-development opportunity. A first-profit close, immediate breakeven assumption or hindsight peak exit is forbidden.

selection.failure_action: Close the actual-position bundle immediately if neither selectable burden passes; do not invent another phenotype from the same 13 positions.

stop_rules: Use only the fixed T03-T15 population and the one permitted T15 replay.
Do not treat the safety stop, missed Cross, shutdowns, chart gaps or manual action as research subjects.
Do not inspect broker positions, orders, deals or account history.
Do not change or restart the active Live terminal, dashboard, package, settings, state or log files.
Do not select an exit, stop, trail, threshold, strategy exception or Live candidate in unit 020.
Descriptive fields outside the three frozen burdens cannot rescue a failed burden.
